title: ephemeral-region-bypass-and-weighted-shedder-repair
author: Anika Patel
release_notes: Fixes a race in ephemeral region bypass and corrects weighted load-shed calculations to avoid tenant starvation during regional partial outages. Not user-facing API change; operational impact only.
commits: b3c9a8f: detect and tag ephemeral bypass windows
d1f0e2a: clamp weighted-shedder scores and restore fairness guard
e7a4b2d: add telemetry metrics for bypass_count and per-tenant-shed-rate
f0d3c19: unit tests for weighted shedder edgecases
a9e1b55: integration test for regional bypass -> reinstate path
description:
Context: During an incident on 2026-02-02 we observed tenants being effectively starved when a transient regional control-plane hiccup triggered an ephemeral 'region bypass' flow. The bypass path was designed to let healthy regions accept traffic while a small set of nodes in the affected region drained, but a race and an over-aggressive weighted-shed calculation amplified shedding for medium-priority tenants. This PR fixes the race and restores the intended fairness guard.

Motivation: Prevent tenant starvation and improve survivability of hosted inference for partial-region outages. Avoid cascading degraded quality (higher latency + dropped requests) caused by incorrect weight normalization and incorrect bypass window semantics.

What I changed (summary):
- runtime/election/region_bypass.go: tighten ephemeral bypass window semantics and add deterministic tagging so a region bypass has a clear open/close lifecycle (avoid lingering bypass tags that caused double-shedding).
- runtime/shedder/weighted_shedder.go: clamp intermediate scores, normalize per-tenant weight contributions, and reintroduce a minimum-fairness floor that prevents cumulative shed probability from exceeding expected bounds for mid-tier tenants.
- Added comprehensive unit tests and an integration test that simulates a two-region failover with staggered reinstate to reproduce and validate fix.
- observability: emit bypass_count, bypass_window_ms, per_tenant_shed_rate metrics and structured bypass events for post-incident analysis.
- controllers/failover: ensure orchestrator acknowledges 'bypass closed' signals only after KV sync completes to prevent premature traffic re-routing.
- docs/ops/regional-failover-playbook.md: updated playbook with a new troubleshooting section for ephemeral bypass misfires and recommended query statements for telemetry.

Why this is safe: Changes are scoped to the runtime and controllers that orchestrate failover and shedding. No external API changes. Default configurations were tightened but kept conservative (backwards-compatible). The fairness floor guards against regression that previously surfaced in production.

Checklist: 
- [x] Reproduced the issue with a deterministic integration test that failed prior to changes.
- [x] Added unit tests for weighted_shedder edgecases.
- [x] Telemetry added and registered in registry YAML.
- [x] Updated ops playbook and logging docs.
- [x] Ran full CI + integration with simulated regions (see CI run #128).
- [x] Smoke-tested in a staging cluster with synthetic traffic and tenant mixes.

Tests & CI: Initial CI run failed (flake) due to an unrelated integration timeout in orchestrator_integration_test (flaky heartbeat). I pushed a retry fix to the test harness and re-ran. Final CI: all checks passed (unit, lint, integration, e2e-sim). See CI summary: unit=pass, lint=pass, integration=pass, e2e-sim=pass.

Review notes and highlights: 
- The fairness floor is tunable via pkg/config/defaults.json under shedder.min_fairness (default 0.05). The value was chosen conservatively after simulation runs described in ENG-1724.
- Telemetry tags include region_id, bypass_tag, tenant_tier, and shed_reason to support rapid post-incident triage.

Small code snippets (illustrative):
- region_bypass.go (new close confirmation):
  if kvSync.CompletedFor(region) && bypassWindow.Expired() {
      tag.Close("ephemeral-bypass")
  }
- weighted_shedder.go (clamp logic):
  score := clamp(rawScore, 0.0, 0.85) // prevent full probability under burst
  score = max(score, cfg.MinFairnessFloor)

Migration notes: No migration scripts required. Ops should watch telemetry: bypass_count and per_tenant_shed_rate for the first 24 hours after rollout. If you observe persistent high bypass_count, follow the updated playbook section to force-close stale bypass windows and inspect KV sync latencies.

Related work and timeline: This is a targeted hotfix branched from main after the incident on 2026-02-02. Follow-ups planned (ENG-1731) include a broader audit of shedder normalization across other admission paths and a small perf optimization to avoid extra allocations when computing per-tenant scores.

Merge outcome: Approved by Diego Morales and Lena Fischer after tech discussion on fairness floor and telemetry. Final approval from SRE (Owen Park) for operational readiness. Merged to main via squash on 2026-02-20.

Notes for on-call: If customers report sudden QoS regression for mid-tier tenants after the merge, check per_tenant_shed_rate and tenant_scoring_breakdown metrics. Revert plan: revert commit b3c9a8f..a9e1b55 as a single revert (squash) and roll back in the same release window.
